Regnskap field dictionary: filing JSON paths to English column names

Source: R/tidybrreg-package.R
regnskap_dict.Rd

A tibble mapping dot paths of the Regnskapsregisteret filing JSON to English column names and R types, with the columns of field_dict. brreg_regnskap() applies it exactly as brreg_entity() applies field_dict: leaves outside the three statement objects become the filing's scalar columns, leaves inside them become the item codes of the nested items table, and paths absent from the dictionary pass through with auto-generated snake_case names. Source spellings such as regnkapsprinsipper and sumInnskuttEgenkaptial are the API's own.

Usage

regnskap_dict

Format

A tibble with 46 rows and 3 columns:

api_path

Dot-notation path in the filing JSON (e.g. "regnskapsperiode.tilDato", "eiendeler.sumEiendeler").

col_name

English name used in package output: a column of the filing row or an item code (e.g. "period_end", "total_assets").

type

R type for coercion: "character", "Date", "integer", "numeric", or "logical".

Source

Package-authored; see tidybrreg_provenance.

See also

brreg_regnskap(), regnskap_groups, regnskap_items.

Other tidybrreg reference data: field_dict, legal_forms, regnskap_groups, regnskap_items, role_groups, role_types, tidybrreg_provenance

Examples

regnskap_dict
#> # A tibble: 46 × 3
#>    api_path                       col_name             type     
#>    <chr>                          <chr>                <chr>    
#>  1 id                             filing_id            integer  
#>  2 journalnr                      journal_nr           character
#>  3 regnskapstype                  account_type         character
#>  4 virksomhet.organisasjonsnummer org_nr               character
#>  5 virksomhet.organisasjonsform   legal_form           character
#>  6 virksomhet.morselskap          parent_company       logical  
#>  7 regnskapsperiode.fraDato       period_start         Date     
#>  8 regnskapsperiode.tilDato       period_end           Date     
#>  9 valuta                         currency             character
#> 10 avviklingsregnskap             liquidation_accounts logical  
#> # ℹ 36 more rows
regnskap_dict[regnskap_dict$type == "numeric", ]
